# Docs by LangChain

> Documentation for LangSmith, Fleet, and our open source packages.

- [AGENT DEVELOPMENT LIFECYCLE (1478 pages)](https://docs.langchain.com/_llms/agent-development-lifecycle.md): Documentation for AGENT DEVELOPMENT LIFECYCLE.
- [PRODUCTS AND SETUP (180 pages)](https://docs.langchain.com/_llms/products-and-setup.md): Documentation for PRODUCTS AND SETUP.

## Other

- [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/javascript/langchain/mcp/index.md): Connect LangChain agents to MCP servers with the MCPAdapter, built on FastMCP.
